title: Garlic-Caper Chicken
subtitle: with Creamy Calabrian Zucchini & Orzo

ingredients.note: Whole Dried Basil, Sage, Oregano, Savory, Rosemary, Thyme & Marjoram

steps.title: Prepare the ingredients
instructions: Fill a medium pot or a large pot if you're cooking 4 servings 3/4 of the way up with salted water; cover and heat to boiling on high.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Halve the zucchini lengthwise, then thinly slice crosswise.
Roughly chop the capers.
Peel and roughly chop 2 cloves of garlic.
Quarter and deseed the lemon.

steps.title: Cook the pasta
instructions: Add the pasta to the pot of boiling water. Cook, uncovered, 7 to 9 minutes, or until tender. Turn off the heat.
Drain thoroughly and return to the pot. Cover to keep warm.

steps.title: Cook the zucchini
instructions: Meanwhile, in a medium pan or a large pan if you're cooking 4 servings (nonstick, if you have one), heat a drizzle of olive oil on medium-high until hot.
Add the sliced zucchini in an even layer. Cook, without stirring, 2 to 3 minutes, or until lightly browned.

Add as much of the chile paste as you'd like, depending on how spicy you'd like the dish to be; season with salt and pepper. Cook, stirring frequently, 2 to 3 minutes, or until thoroughly combined and the zucchini is softened.
Transfer to a plate; cover with foil to keep warm.
Rinse and wipe out the pan.

steps.title: Cook the chicken
instructions: Pat the chicken dry with paper towels; season on both sides with salt, pepper, and enough of the Italian seasoning to coat (you may have extra).
In the same pan, heat a drizzle of olive oil on medium-high until hot.
Add the seasoned chicken. Cook 6 to 7 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked through.* *The USDA recommends a minimum safe cooking temperature of 165°F for chicken.
Leaving any browned bits (or fond) in the pan, transfer to a cutting board.

steps.title: Make the garlic-caper topping
instructions: In the pan of reserved fond, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil or 2 tablespoons of olive oil if you're cooking 4 servings on medium-high until hot.
Add the chopped capers and chopped garlic. Cook, stirring constantly, 30 seconds to 1 minute, or until slightly softened.
Turn off the heat and stir in the juice of 2 lemon wedges.

steps.title: Finish the pasta & serve your dish
instructions: To the pot of cooked pasta, add the cooked zucchini, cream, and the juice of the remaining lemon wedges. Stir to combine.
Taste, then season with salt and pepper if desired.
Slice the cooked chicken crosswise.
Serve the finished pasta topped with the sliced chicken and garlic-caper topping. Garnish with the cheese.

review: servings: card is '2 or 4 servings'; transcribed the 2-serving quantities (4-serving: 4 chicken breasts, 1/2 cup cream, 1/2 lb orzo, 1 Tbsp chile paste, 2 zucchini, 2 Tbsps capers; others unchanged). The italic 4-serving notes in steps 1, 3, and 5 are kept word for word
